responsibility: Writes dataset records and anomaly records to the project CSV formats.
Defines immutable and mutable data contracts for dataset scans and scan anomalies.
Traverses dataset subject and eye directories and converts image files into scan results.
Provides shared field definitions for dataset and segmentation CSV files.
Reads and validates image metadata required by dataset scanning.
Parses CLI commands and coordinates dataset scanning, segmentation, normalization, and iris encoding workflows.
non_responsibilities: Does not implement image processing algorithms.
Does not own filesystem serialization details.

public_interface.name: main
public_interface.description: Parses arguments, invokes the selected workflow, prints its required summary, and returns a process exit code.
preconditions: Arguments are either omitted or follow a supported iris command.
postconditions: The selected workflow has been invoked and a summary has been printed.

responsibility: Maps segmented iris boundaries to normalized polar image coordinates and samples image pixels.
Detects pupil and iris boundaries from an input iris image.
Writes normalization anomaly records to CSV.
Builds a validity mask in normalized coordinates from an image and segmentation record.
Defines data contracts for normalized images, masks, destinations, results, and batch outcomes.
Orchestrates single-image and dataset normalization workflows.
Persists normalized images and validity masks as PNG files.
Derives subject and eye identity from dataset image paths.
Writes segmentation records and segmentation anomaly records to CSV.
Defines data contracts for boundaries, segmentation results, records, anomalies, and batches.
Renders segmentation boundaries as overlay images and saves them.
Orchestrates segmentation for individual images and dataset CSV rows.
Validates detected pupil and iris geometry against image bounds and domain rules.
Defines data contracts for Gabor encoding configuration, packed iris codes, masks, anomalies, and batch outcomes.
non_responsibilities: Does not load images or perform convolution.
Does not write binary or CSV files.

responsibility: Builds the configured 2D complex Gabor filter bank and computes sampled complex responses for grayscale normalized images.
non_responsibilities: Does not interpret dataset paths or CLI arguments.
Does not quantize responses into packed output bytes.

public_interface.name: encode_responses
public_interface.description: Applies the filter bank at configured wavelengths and orientations and returns responses on the coarse sampling grid.
preconditions: Image is a two-dimensional numeric array.
Config has positive scales, orientations, and grid_step.
postconditions: Responses cover every configured filter and grid location.

responsibility: Coordinates image and mask loading, Gabor response quantization, mask-bit generation, byte packing, and batch anomaly reporting.
non_responsibilities: Does not define Gabor mathematics beyond calling the filter module.
Does not decide CLI argument parsing.

public_interface.name: encode_one
public_interface.description: Loads one normalized image and mask, produces packed iris code and packed validity mask, and returns an anomaly on a defined failure.
preconditions: Image and mask paths identify readable images with matching dimensions.
postconditions: Success returns code and mask bytes with MSB-first packing, or failure returns one issue from the encoding anomaly vocabulary.

public_interface.name: encode_dataset
public_interface.description: Encodes paired normalized and mask dataset trees while preserving relative image structure and collecting per-image anomalies.
preconditions: Both roots are accessible and use the expected subject/eye layout.
postconditions: Every discovered image contributes to processed, successful, or failed counts.

responsibility: Persists packed iris codes and packed masks as binary files while preserving dataset-relative paths.
non_responsibilities: Does not compute filter responses or quantization.
Does not discover input files or create anomaly records.

public_interface.name: write_result
public_interface.description: Writes the packed code and optional packed mask to a single-image destination or dataset-preserving destination.
preconditions: Result contains packed bytes and destination directories are writable.
postconditions: The code file is written and the mask file is written when requested.
